facebook.hookZone: first 125 characters decide 'See more' — keyword + hook go here
facebook.extras: For va-lucknow add Location: Vikas Nagar, Lucknow. For video posts write a separate one-line video title.

instagram.altText: Generate descriptive alt text containing the primary keyword naturally.
instagram.onScreenText: Suggest one short on-screen line for a Reels cover.
instagram.links: Say link in bio or give the canonical WhatsApp number.
instagram.locationTag: For va-lucknow suggest Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh or the rotated city.

title.rule: Primary keyword in first 40 chars. Put #Shorts in the description, not the title.

tags.rule: Mix primary, secondary, geo, Hinglish and brand variants.

youtube.pinnedComment: Question to viewers plus one WhatsApp CTA.
youtube.thumbnailText: Two to four words, not a copy of the title.
youtube.category: Education for RX/VA and mentor content; otherwise People & Blogs.
youtube.language: Use Hindi metadata when the voiceover is Hinglish.

x.threads: For deeper topics generate 4–6 posts; post one must stand alone.
x.rule: No hashtag stuffing or opening emoji. Use the keyword naturally once.
